rules.no_crediting_s1_with_l5_fills: separate ledgers; S1 inventory moves only on an EVIDENCED_* verdict on S1's own order
rules.no_touch_equals_fill: only the frozen classifier's evidenced verdicts move inventory; uncertain verdicts are excluded
rules.no_future_information: Book.at(t) returns the latest row at or before t; prints from (t-1, t]; the tape is walked strictly forward

divergence.definition: D2: the first second at which L5 holds a matched pair and S1 holds none. Chosen as the marker because it is the first divergence in POSITION rather than in quote.
